info.name: EchoZero API
info.description:
Public EchoZero REST + MCP API collection.

Set the `baseUrl` variable to https://mcp.echozero.app and supply your own `apiKey` / `hmacSecretKey`. Every credential in this collection is a {{variable}} placeholder — no real keys are included.

Docs: https://docs.echozero.app  ·  Signing: https://docs.echozero.app/guides/webhook-security

request.description: Health check endpoint. No authentication required. Returns { "Status": "Success" }.

item.name: HMAC Signing
item.description: HMAC-SHA256 request signing tests on /api/v1 routes. Signing scheme: HMAC-SHA256(secretKey, timestamp + METHOD + path + body). Headers: x-api-key, x-signature, x-timestamp. JWT/OAuth session auth is exempt.

request.description: API-key /v1/ request without x-signature must return 401.

exec: const stringToSign = ts + method + path + body;

request.description: Invalid signature should return 401.
Timestamp older than 5 minutes should return 401.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public authentication endpoints for login, signup (email + Google OAuth), refresh, and sign-out. Successful responses carry `tokens.accessToken` / `tokens.refreshToken` in the JSON body. The bundled test scripts auto-populate the `accessToken` / `refreshToken` / `mfaAccessToken` collection variables so subsequent requests can use `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

request.description: Check whether a username is already registered. No authentication required.
Unified login / signup lookup. For new users, include `username`, `receiveMarketingOffers`, `agreedToTerms`, `promoCode`, `referralCode` as needed.
Exchange an email verification code for access + refresh tokens. When MFA is required the response flags `mfaRequired: true` and returns a `tokens.mfaAccessToken` instead of access/refresh tokens.
Returns the Google OAuth URL for the user to redirect to. Currently only `GOOGLE` is supported by this endpoint.
Complete a Google OAuth flow. Use `state` from the previous `/auth/social/url` call and `code` from the Google redirect callback.
Exchange the refresh token stored in `refreshToken` for a new access token. Updates the `accessToken` collection variable on success.
Revoke the refresh token. Always returns `{ success: true }` once processed.
Demonstrates that `/v1/users/me` accepts a user JWT (`Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`) in addition to API keys.
Generate a new API key + secret key pair. Returns rawKey and rawSecretKey (shown only once).

item.name: User (v1)

request.description: Body matches GraphQL SaveUserInterestsInput (BotInterest enum values).
Must reference a public, active trading bot id.

Follow an internal agent. tradeMode must match the current wallet toggle (virtual: TEST_TRADING/ALERTS_ONLY; real: FULL_TRADING/AUTO_TRADING). Canonical wallet scope is walletContext. USD_AMOUNT/SOL_AMOUNT soft-reserve capital against wallet available for that walletContext. Over-allocation → INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE. Response includes allocatedUsd/inUseUsd/withdrawableUsd plus venue, lockedInPositionsUsd, pendingDeltaUsd, bridgeStatus. Hyperliquid REAL also returns hyperliquidTotalEquityUsd / hyperliquidFreeMarginUsd (shared account). PERCENTAGE_RANGE does not reserve fixed capital.

Update trade mode, capital allocation, go-live, pause/resume (isPaused), or closeAllTrades on an existing internal agent subscription. Requires prior POST .../subscriptions. tradeMode must remain compatible with the current walletContext/toggle. FULL/TEST → ALERTS in real: pass closeAllTrades true to exit now, omit/false to keep open (self-managed, agent stops SL/TP). Virtual never prompts this sheet. If the current mode row is missing after a wallet toggle, PATCH returns AGENT_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED until the user subscribes in that mode. Lowering USD/SOL allocation below open-trade usage → ALLOCATION_FUNDS_IN_USE. Hyperliquid REAL add/withdraw is async: allocatedUsd changes only after bridgeStatus=CONFIRMED.

Add USD to the agent pool. Jupiter/virtual apply immediately. Hyperliquid REAL: credits existing HL free margin first, then bridges only the Solana shortfall (HL $5 deposit min, no $10 platform floor). Sets bridgeStatus=BRIDGING and pendingDeltaUsd, returns ~3 min ETA; allocatedUsd updates only after on-chain confirm. In-flight/FAILED bridge → ALLOCATION_BRIDGE_IN_FLIGHT.

query.description: true = unsubscribe sheet (entire outstanding success fee)

request.description: Preview Gross − pending fees − slippage − dust − success fee = you receive. Success fee is 8% EchoZero + creator% of net realized profit only (max(0, equity − deposit)), never of principal. Ledger rows: depositedUsd, realizedPnlUsd, unrealizedPnlUsd, netRealizedProfitUsd, feeBaseUsd, platformFeeUsd, creatorFeeUsd, netUserPayoutUsd. Confirm-sheet: agentBalanceUsd, stayingInOpenTradesUsd, successFeeDueUsd, remainingInAgentUsd, successFeeRule. fullExit=true for unsubscribe; closeAllTrades=true for close-all. Does not move funds. Jupiter/virtual: ledger math. Hyperliquid REAL: live withdrawable + Relay quote.

Withdraw USD from this agent's leftover only. Open trades on THIS agent block unused capital. Other agents do not. Hyperliquid REAL reclaims min(requested, live free collateral). Success is async: pendingDeltaUsd is negative until reclaim confirms.

Hyperliquid agents reject unsubscribe (`HL_UNSUBSCRIBE_OPEN_POSITIONS`) only when this agent still has an open DB trade. Other agents' positions and wallet-wide venue size do not block. Reclaim returns only this agent's leftover; other Hyperliquid allocations are not drained. keepTrade=false does not auto-close HL trades. After HL→Sol reclaim (or when HL already released this agent's leftover), the pool is closed so returned USDC is AVAILABLE, not IN USE.

item.name: MCP protocol (Streamable HTTP)
item.description: Not under /api. Requires x-api-key on every request (including initialize). Session is bound to that key. Copy mcp-session-id from the initialize response into header mcp-session-id for tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read, prompts/list, prompts/get, and GET /mcp/sse. Task 4.3 read-only tools, Task 4.4 action tools, Task 4.5 resources, Task 4.6 prompts, Task 4.7 REST-backed error/response formatting, and Task 4.8 upload_agent_avatar are scope-gated and forward to or reference existing REST endpoints.

request.description: JSON-RPC initialize. Save response header mcp-session-id (e.g. as collection variable mcpSessionId).

Tools reflect API key scopes. Task 4.3 read-only tools include get_token/get_tokens/get_trending_tokens for read:tokens, get_trades for read:trades, get_wallet_mode for read:wallet, etc. Task 4.4 action tools include create_strategy, create_agent, ai_chat, deposit, edit_profile, mark_all_read, and claim_reward when the matching write scopes are present.
Calls the Task 4.3 get_tokens tool. Requires read:tokens and returns the wrapped REST JSON from GET /api/v1/tokens.
Calls the Task 4.4 mark_all_read tool. Requires write:notifications and forwards to POST /api/v1/notifications/mark-all-read.
Demonstrates Task 4.4 financial confirmation. JWT/user sessions return requiresConfirmation first; API-key sessions execute directly.
Lists Task 4.5 resources allowed by the current API key scopes, such as echozero://tokens/trending and echozero://user/profile.
Reads the Task 4.5 trending tokens resource. Requires read:tokens and returns application/json resource contents.
Lists Task 4.6 prompt templates allowed by the current API key scopes.
Gets the Task 4.6 strategy performance analysis prompt. Requires read:strategies and read:trades.
Calls the Task 4.8 upload_agent_avatar tool. Requires write:agents, uploads base64 image data through storage, and updates Agent.imageUrl for the owned agent.
Demonstrates Task 4.7 REST-backed tool error formatting. Requires read:strategies. Expected result.isError=true with structured JSON text containing error.code, error.message, and details.statusCode.
